messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Space-time contours
parts:
Lucy, I didn't go load the splancs package because one thing that
immediately jumps out at me is that your "Date" field is a string.
Probably the first step is to convert it to a true date, e.g.

library(lubridate)
sample$TrueDate <- dmy(paste0("01/",sample$Date))

That done, you have something you can work with:

test <- interp(sample$TrueDate,sample$y,sample$x,duplicate='mean')
filled.contour(test)

Hope this is a useful first step.

Ben
